dct_description_sm: The objective of this research were to determine if the addition of a fungicide/bactericide (chlorothalonil or copper hydroxide) to rimsulfuron, thifensulfuron, rimsulfuron plus metribuzin, or thifensulfuron plus metribuzin increased injury to tomato, reduced weed control, and reduced tomato yield.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Weed control in processing tomato (Lycopersicon esculentum) with Rimsulfuron and Thifensulfuron applies alone or with Chlorothalonil or copper pesticides
